tools.name: submit_move_quote_from_page
tools.description: Create an AnyVan quote from natural-language move details and navigate this tab to the created quote page.

pickup.description: Pickup endpoint details in the Booking Gateway quote shape.

location.description: Location details. Prefer query for natural text like "London SW1A 0AA"; use placeId only for a real Google Place ID. Booking Gateway resolves town, city, postcode, countryCode, country, addressLines, or coordinates.

query.description: Natural location text from the user, such as "London SW1A 0AA", "Manchester M1 1AA", "London", or "GB".

address.description: Full natural address text when the user gave an address-like location.

placeId.description: Google Place ID, such as "ChIJdd4hrwug2EcRmSrV3Vo6llI". Do not put natural text here unless no better field is available.

latitude.description: Latitude when exact coordinates are available.

longitude.description: Longitude when exact coordinates are available.

postcode.description: Full or partial postcode, such as "SW1A 1AA".

addressLines.description: Street address lines for an address-like natural location.

countryCode.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, such as "GB".

type.description: Property type for house moves, such as "house", "flat", "apartment", "studio", "flatshare", or "storage".

bedrooms.description: Booking Gateway bedrooms object for house moves.

count.description: Bedroom count as a number, such as 3.

floor.description: Floor as natural text or a Booking Gateway token, such as "ground floor", "3rd floor", "ground-floor", or "3rd-floor".

liftAvailable.description: Whether a lift is available at this endpoint, when supplied or clearly implied.

liftType.description: Lift type when supplied, such as "no-lift", "standard", "large", or "extra-large".

floorNumber.description: Numeric floor number when known. Use 0 for ground floor, 1 for first floor, and so on.

parkingAvailable.description: Whether parking is available at this endpoint, if known.

accessNotes.description: Access notes, such as parking, stairs, or loading restrictions, if supplied.

delivery.description: Delivery endpoint details in the Booking Gateway quote shape.
